[[File:Starkiller_felucia.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Galen Marek seen wearing the jungle combat gear on Felucia]]
The '''jungle combat gear''' was a [[uniform]] inspired by ancient [[Sith Warrior]]s from [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was designed to give maximum flexibility for acrobatic martial arts in dense jungle terrain. [[Galen Marek]] wore jungle combat gear on his mission to rescue [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The jungle combat gear was featured in the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Force Unleashed'' video game]] and was one of the multiple costumes that players could choose to equip.<ref name="TFU" />
